Marketing Automation

Consistent follow-up without the spreadsheet chaos.

Automated workflows, CRM processes and marketing systems that keep follow-up consistent as you grow.

Book a Strategy Call →View Pricing →

The problem

Enquiries live in WhatsApp chats, inboxes and spreadsheets. Follow-ups depend on someone remembering, customers hear nothing after buying, and nobody has a clear view of the pipeline.

Our solution

We map how customers move through your business, choose tools that fit your team and budget, and automate the repeatable steps: confirmations, reminders, nurture sequences and handovers. Messaging respects consent and platform rules, and people stay involved where judgement matters.

Our process

  1. Journey and process mapping

    How leads and customers move today and where they stall.

  2. Tool selection

    CRM and email tools matched to your team and budget.

  3. Workflow design

    Triggers, messages, tasks and handovers defined and approved.

  4. Build and integrate

    Systems configured and connected to forms and channels.

  5. Test and train

    Real-world testing and team training.

  6. Monitor and improve

    Review of workflow performance and data quality.

Deliverables

  • Customer journey and process map
  • CRM set-up or clean-up
  • Email and approved-channel messaging workflows
  • Lead routing and task automation
  • Integrations between forms, CRM and email
  • Pipeline dashboards
  • Documentation and team training

Ideal customer

  • Teams with growing enquiry or order volume
  • E-commerce brands that want retention and win-back flows
  • Sales teams that need a reliable pipeline view

A note on results

We do not guarantee specific results. Outcomes depend on your market, offer, budget and competition. We agree measures and targets with you, report honestly and recommend what to do next.
